reviews.text: If you're looking for the ultimate futuristic dining experience in West Hollywood, you absolutely have to visit the Tesla Diner. The prices are surprisingly reasonable for such a unique concept, and the quality of the food served in those custom Cybertruck boxes is genuinely impressive. So the staff moves with this high energy and you know they are super excited to show you around this place that opened on July 21, 2025. But it is a little disappointing that no alcohol is currently served here despite having those designated bar areas set up. And honestly, seeing the V4 Superchargers right there at the diner just makes the whole vibe so electric and fun that you will want to come back again and again!

I was starving after a long drive but the service was painfully slow despite the place being mostly empty. Even though they built a fancy bar area, the staff refused to serve alcohol so the whole vibe felt incomplete.

The carhop SERVICE is absolutely AMAZING compared to the sluggish staff at every other retro diner I've visited. In contrast, the PRICES for the burgers are surprisingly reasonable considering the location and the tech.
